title: MIAMI AT THE HELM EP. 2 RECAP: The Superyacht-Watch Connection - Inside Miami’s Luxury Timepiece Scene
description: FYI Yachts' 'Miami At The Helm' podcast, featuring The Watch Concierge, dives into the luxury link between yachting and high-end watches. Learn why top collectors choose the Rolex Sea-Dweller and how on-demand service defines Miami's elite lifestyle.
html:
Why Yacht Owners Collect Watches: The FYI Yachts Team Explores the Inseparable Link Between Sea and Style

In the second episode of Miami At The Helm, hosts Joel Gomez and Ralph Navarro of FYI Yachts sat down with a true expert in high-value luxury assets: Diego Caro, The Watch Concierge at On Demand Luxe. The conversation quickly moved beyond business into the passion, prestige, and personalized service that connects the world of superyachts with the scene for highly sought-after timepieces.

This episode is an essential listen for anyone who understands that luxury is found in detail, history, and unparalleled access.

90ft Sunseeker 2024 – WORTH THE WAIT

The Inseparable Correlation: Yachts and Watches

The hosts quickly noted that once someone becomes a yacht owner, they almost invariably become a serious watch collector. Diego confirmed this synergy, explaining that both passions share a commitment to precision engineering, exquisite craftsmanship, and exclusivity.

Listen to the full episode on YouTube: Miami At The Helm Ep.2 – Timepieces, Miami Culture & Big Money

Key Takeaways for the HNW Collector

  • The Yachting Timepiece: When asked to name the ultimate watch that resonates with a yachting lifestyle—from a classic motor yacht to a modern Pershing—the panel consistently highlighted models built for performance and durability, ultimately agreeing on the Rolex Sea-Dweller.
  • The Classic Choice: Diego noted that no matter the boat, the Patek Philippe Nautilus and the Rolex Submariner remain timeless classics that are universally seen on the wrists of successful yacht brokers and collectors.
  • The Broker’s Milestone: Ralph Navarro shared a personal story, noting that his first expensive watch was a two-tone Submariner, bought in 1997 at the first Miami Boat Show—marking a tradition of buying a new Rolex at every boat show, linking timepieces directly to professional success.

The Concierge Service: Taking Luxury On Demand

The conversation provided a rare glimpse into the world of luxury asset acquisition. Diego explained that his service is designed to eliminate the need for clients to visit a traditional building or shop.

“I provide a service where I will come to your home. I will come to your office. I will come to your yacht. I will travel out of state.”

This elevated, on-demand service is exactly why FYI Yachts partners with On Demand Luxe: they meet the high-net-worth client where they are, ensuring security, discretion, and access to inventory that is virtually impossible to find elsewhere.

An Audemars Piguet Surprise

The episode featured a significant surprise when Diego presented Ralph Navarro with a long-awaited timepiece: a rare Audemars Piguet (AP) Ultra-Thin Flying Tourbillon in rose gold (reference 26510 O). The watch is noted for its high complication and extreme limitation (only three or four units were reportedly on the market globally at that time).

Diego also shared the story of his most high-value transaction—an approximately $400,000 sale of an AP concept watch, specifically the limited edition Black Panther Flying Tourbillon, demonstrating the level of inventory and trust a watch concierge operates with.

Experience the Conversation

This episode offers incredible insight into the world of high-value collecting and the seamless service that defines the Miami luxury sector. It’s a testament to the importance of partnership, trust, and exceptional service in both yacht brokerage and horology.
